editorial:
Imagine being a teenage scout who just wants to hang out with friends, only to find your quiet town overrun by flesh-eating zombies. That is the wild ride you get here. Three lifelong scout buddies team up with a tough cocktail waitress named Denise, and together they turn their camping skills into survival tactics. The vibe is loud, silly, and packed with gross-out laughs, blending teen comedy energy with splattery horror. It never takes itself too seriously, which makes it easy to enjoy with friends on a movie night.

The action moves fast, the jokes land often, and the cast sells the chaos with big, goofy energy. Pros include creative zombie kills and a fun pace; cons include crude humor that may not be for everyone and a thin story. If you like silly horror comedies, you will have a blast. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, the scouts and Denise lure the zombie horde into a building and blow it up, saving the survivors at the party. Ben finally gets his moment with crush Kendall, and the group earns their badges as unlikely heroes. A last gag hints the zombie threat is not fully over, leaving room for more chaos.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly zombie comedies and teen adventure movies.
